item.title: Ai Yori Aoshi ~Shuutou~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: J.C.Staff
  • 発売日: 2004-06-24
  • スコア: なし (1 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 藍より青し ～秋冬～
  • 英語名: Ai Yori Aoshi Shuutou

あらすじ

The popular comic and animation series “Ai Yori Aoshi’’ is finally available on PC with beautiful CG!

Cherry blossom in the spring, beach swimming in the summer, autumn leaves in the fall, and snow in the winter… The residents of Sakuraba mansion go on excursions! Short stories that unfold in each season: spring, summer, fall, and winter, where the events change depending on the choices you make.
